patch_description: Key changes vs current code: (1) optimize on squared distances with a p-norm smooth surrogate whose beta/p is annealed (p: 4→16→40), giving accurate gradients near the piecewise exact ratio; (2) analytic gradients (fast, exact) fed to L-BFGS-B; (3) dedicated symmetric seed family — icosahedron + antipodal poles and rotated/perturbed variants — since the known optimum for 14 points on a sphere is symmetric under the icosahedral group; (4) a final antipodal-symmetrization polish: average each point with the negation of its best-matching partner, re-optimize briefly with tight ftol, and keep the result only if the true score improves; (5) exact-score tracking throughout (dmin/dmax)^2 so surrogates never mislead selection. This pushes toward the reference squared ratio 0.24005 (score 1.0) rather than the current 0.22.
